7355.title: CPU profile attribution assumes a shared clock origin
7355.rootCauseOneLine: Raw V8 profile timestamps are clipped against hrtime stall windows without clock-domain alignment; controlled origin shifts erase real sampled ownership.
7355.proposedFix: Calibrate the main-thread clock around both profiler boundaries, align only the attribution timeline, and decline attribution when clock bounds disagree.
7355.caveats: Two clean Linux/Node 22 checkouts reproduce the real-worker failure with investigator-controlled clock origins. The reported native macOS/Node 26 offset is unverified. Regression code and output are inline per reports-repository policy. Unrelated baseline build/toolchain failures remain.
